sections.title: A TORONTO ORIGINAL. BUILT ON INSTINCT.
sections.html:
The Powerhouse story

A TORONTO ORIGINAL.
BUILT ON INSTINCT.

Great faces. Brilliant dialogue. Sensational talent.

Powerhouse Casting is an independent Toronto casting company. Its work spans commercials, comedy, beauty, dramatic performance, children’s content and real-people casting.

The studio’s own profile records more than 10,000 commercials cast. Long-standing relationships with directors, producers and agencies meet an ongoing search for emerging talent.
